name: Wise Widget Manager – Classic Widgets & Sidebar Control
author: bisnusnr

sections.description:
🚀 Take full control of your website’s layout with Wise Widget Manager, the ultimate centralized dashboard for managing sidebars and widget areas in classic WordPress themes.

If you are tired of navigating clunky, slow, or disjointed native admin screens, this plugin is your solution. Wise Widget Manager brings all of your active widgets into a unified, visual interface where you can preview, reorder, and optimize them instantly. It works in perfect harmony with the default WordPress architecture—enhancing your workflow without modifying or breaking your underlying site data.

Whether you need to clean up messy sidebars, control who sees what content, or optimize your site layout for mobile users, Wise Widget Manager gives you a faster, smarter workspace.

📌 Quick Tip for Adding New Widgets:
To add a brand-new widget to your site, simply use the native WordPress flow via Appearance → Widgets. Once added, it will instantly sync and appear inside your Wise Widget Manager dashboard, ready for quick organization and visibility tweaks.

Features

  • 🎛️ All-in-One Dashboard – View and manage every active widget across every sidebar on a single, intuitive page. Eliminate tedious tab-hopping.
  • 🫳 Effortless Drag-and-Drop – Rearrange your layout and widget priority instantly with smooth, responsive drag-and-drop functionality. Absolutely no code required.
  • 👁️ Safe Live Previews – Test widget modifications safely within an isolated iframe preview before publishing. Ensure your layout looks perfect without risking your live site.
  • 🗑️ Instant One-Click Removal – Instantly purge unwanted widgets from any sidebar area to keep your back-end clean and clutter-free.
  • 📱 Device-Specific Visibility – Dynamically show or hide widgets based on the visitor’s device. Tailor unique experiences for Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile audiences.
  • 🔒 User Authentication Rules – Control visibility by user status. Display widgets exclusively to logged-in members, hide them from public visitors, or vice versa—ideal for membership sites.
  • 🧱 Hybrid Block & Classic Support – Manage legacy classic widgets and modern Gutenberg blocks side-by-side within the exact same seamless interface.
  • 🔍 Instant Widget Search – Quickly locate specific widgets across dozens of sidebars using a powerful, real-time search filter.
  • ⚡ Lightning-Fast & Lightweight – Built with an optimized architecture using the WordPress REST API, ensuring zero bloat and absolute minimal impact on site speed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Tools → Wise Widget Manager
  4. Start managing your widgets
sections.faq:
Does this replace the default WordPress widgets screen?

No. It enhances the default system by providing a centralized management dashboard.

Is it compatible with block widgets?

It is primarily designed for classic widgets, but may work with some block-based widget areas depending on theme support.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight, assets are compiled for production, and it communicates via optimized REST API endpoints.
